name: cowork-skill
description: Cowork OS as a plugin: bootstrap, extend, doctor, end-session.

plugins.name: cowork
plugins.description: Bootstrap a lean instruction backbone (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md shim, MEMORY.md, conventions) into any project, extend it with workstations, rules, agents and skills by convention, audit it with a doctor, and close sessions with an end-of-session capture and git sync.
